newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia should look at tax reform - IMF head.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia should look at tax reform - IMF head.

text.p: The Australian government should consider reforming its tax system to widen its base, International Monetary Fund (IMF) managing director Michel Camdessus said in a newspaper interview. "The day wil come certainly when your government will consider that it will be necessary to go to a more basic reshuffle of your taxation system," Camdessus told The Australian Financial Review.

"The fact that your taxation is based so much on capital and income and, in a very limited way, on sales, is certainly something which prevents your government from having the resource base needed during this time of economic adjustment," he said. "This is certainly one of the structural reforms that are needed and which will be considered, I hope, soon."
Australia is not under IMF supervision.

Camdessus also said the government should aim for a larger budget surplus while the economy was relatively strong and that the official target for underlying inflation of an average two to three percent over the cycle could be tightened.
